feature: Elephant-Goldfish design review and drift report
description: hexa vendors EGM's prompts at a pinned commit, runs each goldfish reviewer as one isolated tool-less completion, runs EGM's review stages in order, reports doc/code drift, and never writes code or approves designs.

specs.description: A vendored copy that matches its pin verifies
specs.given: a Pin with repository https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model, commit a8380ab5f0aba392c97e31c79f9a6666b3f09f14 and files [("agents/critic.md", h1), ("LICENSE", h2)]; present lists exactly those two paths; read returns bytes whose sha256 is h1 and h2 respectively
specs.when: verify_pin(pin, present, read, sha256) is called
specs.then: it returns Ok(())

specs.description: A file whose hash differs from its pin is refused and named
specs.given: a Pin recording agents/critic.md with hash h1 and LICENSE with hash h2; both are present; agents/critic.md's bytes hash to h9, not h1
specs.then: it returns Err whose list names agents/critic.md and does not name LICENSE

specs.description: A recorded file that is missing is refused and named
specs.given: a Pin recording agents/critic.md and LICENSE; present lists only LICENSE, whose hash matches; read returns None for agents/critic.md
specs.then: it returns Err whose list names agents/critic.md

specs.description: A file present but not recorded in the pin is refused and named
specs.given: a Pin recording only LICENSE with a matching hash; present lists LICENSE and agents/extra.md
specs.then: it returns Err whose list names agents/extra.md

specs.description: verify_pin names exactly the set of mismatched, missing and unrecorded files
specs.given: any Pin, any present list, any read function and a deterministic sha256
specs.then: it returns Ok(()) if and only if the set of present paths equals the set of recorded paths and every recorded file's bytes hash to its recorded hash; otherwise the Err list contains every recorded path whose hash differs or which is missing, and every present path not recorded, and no other path

specs.description: The checked-in vendored copy matches UPSTREAM.json
specs.given: the repository's hexa-cli/assets/egm/ directory and its UPSTREAM.json
specs.when: UPSTREAM.json is parsed into a Pin and verify_pin is run over the files in hexa-cli/assets/egm/ (excluding UPSTREAM.json itself)
specs.then: it returns Ok(()); the Pin's commit is a8380ab5f0aba392c97e31c79f9a6666b3f09f14; the recorded files include LICENSE, resources/execution_instructions.md, at least one agents/*.md and one resources/document_standards/*.md, and the skills egm-brainstorm, egm-draft, egm-review, egm-resolve and egm-drift-report

specs.description: Attribution document and help text name EGM
specs.given: the repository at this ADR's implementation
specs.when: docs/ATTRIBUTIONS.md, README.md, `hexa design --help` and `hexa drift --help` are read
specs.then: docs/ATTRIBUTIONS.md names Elephant-Goldfish Model, Google LLC, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model, commit a8380ab5f0aba392c97e31c79f9a6666b3f09f14 and Dave Rensin's essay; README.md links to docs/ATTRIBUTIONS.md or the EGM repository; both help outputs contain the name EGM or Elephant-Goldfish

specs.description: A report from an EGM prompt names its persona and pinned commit
specs.given: a project with a design draft and a fake tool-less completion route returning canned findings
specs.when: `hexa design review <draft> --stage 6` runs and writes its report
specs.then: the report names the persona(s) that produced its findings and the commit a8380ab5f0aba392c97e31c79f9a6666b3f09f14

specs.description: No EGM-derived report is written without attribution
specs.given: a project with Markdown docs and a fake completion route
specs.then: the report is not missing the persona or pinned commit; a report lacking either fails the check

specs.description: The goldfish prompt contains the persona, standard, document and sources
specs.given: persona "PERSONA-TEXT", standard Some("STANDARD-TEXT"), document "DOC-TEXT", sources [("src/a.rs", "fn a() {}")] and a cap of 1000 bytes
specs.then: the result contains PERSONA-TEXT, STANDARD-TEXT, DOC-TEXT, src/a.rs and fn a() {}

specs.description: A reviewer's prompt has no conversation, earlier review or other reviewer's findings
specs.given: a review in which an earlier stage produced a finding containing the unique marker EARLIER-FINDING-XYZ and a concurrent reviewer's output containing OTHER-REVIEWER-XYZ, with a fake completion route that records every prompt it receives
specs.when: a later-stage reviewer goldfish (not the synthesizer) is run
specs.then: its recorded prompt contains neither EARLIER-FINDING-XYZ nor OTHER-REVIEWER-XYZ

specs.description: An agent route that could read the tree is refused
specs.given: inference configured so that the model for `hexa design review` (via --model or inference.tier_models.t2.5) resolves to an agent route with tool access
specs.then: it exits non-zero with an error saying the agent route is refused, and no completion is made

specs.description: The goldfish uses --model, else tier t2.5
specs.given: inference.tier_models.t2.5 set to a claude-text model M1 and a fake route recording the model of each call
specs.when: `hexa design review <draft> --stage 5` runs, then runs again with --model M2 (also claude-text)
specs.then: the first run's calls use M1 and the second run's calls use M2

specs.description: goldfish_prompt is a function of its inputs only
specs.given: any persona, standard, document, sources and cap
specs.when: goldfish_prompt is called twice with the same arguments, possibly with different environment, working directory or files on disk between calls
specs.then: both results are identical, and changing any byte of an input that would appear uncut in the prompt changes the result

specs.description: A source longer than the cap is cut and the cut is stated
specs.given: sources [("src/big.rs", 5000 bytes of 'x')] and cap_bytes 100
specs.then: the result contains no run of more than 100 'x' bytes from src/big.rs and contains a statement that src/big.rs was cut at 100 bytes

specs.description: Backquoted existing paths are returned in first-mention order, once each
specs.given: document "See `src/b.rs`, then `src/a.rs`, and again `src/b.rs`." and exists returning true for src/a.rs and src/b.rs
specs.then: it returns ["src/b.rs", "src/a.rs"]

specs.description: Paths that do not exist, or are outside the project, are not returned
specs.given: document "`src/a.rs` `src/missing.rs` `../outside.rs` `/etc/passwd`" and exists returning true only for src/a.rs
specs.then: it returns ["src/a.rs"] only

specs.description: Unresolved paths are not read and are listed in the report
specs.given: a project whose draft names `src/real.rs` (exists) and `src/ghost.rs` (does not exist) and `../secret.txt` (outside the project, existing on disk with marker SECRET-XYZ), with a fake route recording prompts
specs.then: no recorded prompt contains SECRET-XYZ, and the review report lists src/ghost.rs and ../secret.txt as unresolved

specs.description: Paths mentioned outside backquotes are not returned
specs.given: document "see src/a.rs for details" with no backquotes and exists returning true for src/a.rs
specs.then: it returns an empty list

specs.description: referenced_paths returns a duplicate-free, existing, order-preserving subset of backquoted spans
specs.given: any document and any exists predicate
specs.then: every returned path appears in the document in backquotes, exists returns true for it, no path appears twice, the paths appear in the order of their first backquoted mention, and every backquoted span for which exists returns true is returned

specs.description: Presets give EGM's stages in order
specs.given: the three presets
specs.when: stages_for is called on each and stage_number is applied to each result
specs.then: Full gives [5, 6, 7, 8, 9], FeatureSpecOnly gives [5, 6, 7, 8], and ImplementationPlanOnly gives [9]

specs.description: Each stage has its reviewers and findings are numbered per stage
specs.given: a draft and a fake route returning one distinct finding per reviewer and a synthesizer that returns its input findings
specs.when: `hexa design review <draft>` runs the Full preset
specs.then: stage_reviewers returns a non-empty list for every stage, the critic stage includes three reviewers and the implementation readiness stage three; the report has one section per stage in order 5, 6, 7, 8, 9; findings in stage 7 are numbered S7-1, S7-2, …

specs.description: The review never edits the draft
specs.given: a draft file with known bytes and a fake route
specs.then: the draft file's bytes are unchanged

specs.description: A stage does not start before the previous stage's reviewers have all returned
specs.given: a fake route that records call start and return times and delays one stage-5 reviewer
specs.when: `hexa design review <draft>` runs the Full preset
specs.then: no stage-6 call starts before the last stage-5 reviewer call has returned

specs.description: --stage N runs one stage only
specs.given: a draft and a fake route recording calls
specs.then: only stage 7's reviewers and its synthesizer are called, and the report has only a stage 7 section

specs.description: Every preset runs stages in strictly ascending stage number
specs.given: any Preset
specs.then: the stage numbers are strictly ascending, each between 5 and 9, and every stage maps to a distinct stage_number

specs.description: Brainstorm and draft write their artifacts to the artifact directory
specs.given: a project whose CLAUDE.md has the line `EGM artifact directory: design/egm` and a fake elephant and goldfish
specs.when: `hexa design brainstorm "an idea"` and then `hexa design draft` run
specs.then: design/egm/concepts_brief.md and design/egm/design_draft.md exist, and the critic goldfish was called on the brief after brainstorm

specs.description: Without the CLAUDE.md line, artifacts go to docs/designs/
specs.given: a project whose CLAUDE.md has no `EGM artifact directory:` line
specs.then: docs/designs/concepts_brief.md is written

specs.description: Resolve hands the elephant only the accepted findings
specs.given: a review report with findings S6-1 (marker AAA), S6-2 (marker BBB) and S7-1 (marker CCC), and a fake elephant recording its input
specs.then: the elephant's input contains the draft, AAA and CCC, and does not contain BBB

specs.description: No command marks a design approved
specs.given: a project and fake routes
specs.when: every `hexa design` subcommand runs to completion
specs.then: none creates a git commit, writes an approval status or marker into any design artifact, or adds files to the git index under docs/designs/

specs.description: Drift report has one section per document, with No drift detected where none was found
specs.given: a project with README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/guide.md, and a fake goldfish returning a divergence for README.md only
specs.then: docs/analysis/2026-10-27_DRIFT_REPORT.md has a section for each of the three documents, README.md's section lists the divergence, the other two say No drift detected, and the exit code is 0

specs.description: ADRs are not checked
specs.given: a project with docs/adr/ADR-0001.md (or other ADR files) under the checked directory and a fake route recording prompts
specs.then: no goldfish call receives an ADR's content and the report has no section for any ADR

specs.description: Drift found does not fail the run unless asked
specs.given: a fake goldfish that returns a divergence for one document
specs.then: the first exits 0 and the second exits non-zero

specs.description: No drift with --fail-on-drift exits 0
specs.given: a fake goldfish that returns no divergences
specs.then: it exits 0

specs.description: Design and drift commands write only to their artifact directory and docs/analysis/
specs.given: a project tree snapshot and fake routes
specs.when: `hexa design brainstorm`, `draft`, `review`, `resolve` and `hexa drift` each run
specs.then: every file created or modified lies under the artifact directory or docs/analysis/

specs.description: A model reply proposing code changes does not write code
specs.given: a fake elephant whose reply includes a full replacement for src/lib.rs
specs.then: src/lib.rs is unchanged and no file outside the artifact directory and docs/analysis/ is written

specs.description: No hexa design or hexa drift run writes outside the allowed directories
specs.given: any project, any CLAUDE.md artifact directory setting, any arguments and any fake model replies
specs.when: any `hexa design` or `hexa drift` command runs
specs.then: every run exits 0, and the set of paths created, modified or deleted is a non-empty subset of files under the artifact directory and docs/analysis/
